title: Nano : continous pump unreachable alert
symptom: Since yesterday, I started getting Nano pump unreachable alerts, all the time. Loop works normally except the errors. Downgrading to dev-c 27/10 solves the problem.
cause: The issue was introduced by a commit on the dev branch, likely related to changes around pump connection handling. The exact root cause is not explicitly stated, but the fix commit is referenced.
fix: Fixed by commit 5be253f4c18f95d7fff1db5782bbaa4a6dea494b. Users should update to a version that includes this commit.
